name: Clap Push-Up
steps: Start in a high plank with hands just outside shoulder width and your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest smoothly toward the floor.
Push explosively through both palms to launch your hands off the floor and clap beneath your chest.
Land softly on both hands and bend your elbows immediately to absorb the impact.
tips: Drive your chest and hips away from the floor together without letting your hips sag.
Catch the landing with slightly bent elbows and strong wrists rather than locked arms.
